system.biography:
This creature has the body of a large dog, with a smooth black coat and a mouth full of sharp teeth.

A shadow mastiff is slightly more than 2 feet high at the shoulder and weighs about 200 pounds.

Shadow mastiffs cannot speak, but they understand Common.

Combat

Shadow mastiffs prefer fighting in shadows or dark conditions, which gives them a great advantage.

If a magical light source negates the shadows around them, shadow mastiffs are cunning enough to either move out of the light or back off and break up the opposition with their baying. They have been known to seize and carry off items enspelled with daylight spells.

Bay (Su)

When a shadow mastiff howls or barks, all creatures except evil outsiders within a 300-foot spread must succeed on a DC 13 Will save or become panicked for 2d4 rounds. This is a sonic mind-affecting fear effect. Whether or not the save is successful, an affected creature is immune to the same mastiff’s bay for 24 hours. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Trip (Ex)

A shadow mastiff that hits with its bite attack can attempt to trip the opponent as a free action (+3 check modifier) without making a touch attack or provoking an attack of opportunity. If the attempt fails, the opponent cannot react to trip the shadow mastiff.

Shadow Blend (Su)

In any condition of illumination other than full daylight, a shadow mastiff can disappear into the shadows, giving it total concealment. Artificial illumination, even a light or continual flame spell, does not negate this ability. A daylight spell, however, will.

Skills

*A shadow mastiff has a +4 racial bonus on Survival checks when tracking by scent.

system.benefit: During your action, you designate an opponent and receive a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class against attacks from that opponent. You can select a new opponent on any action.
You get a +4 bonus on initiative checks.

system.description: You can follow the trails of creatures and characters across most types of terrain.
system.benefit: To find tracks or to follow them for 1 hour requires a Survival check. You must make another Survival check every hour to continue following the tracks. The DC depends on the surface and the prevailing conditions.
system.special: A ranger automatically gains Track as a bonus feat at 1st level. He need not select it.

system.description: Make a Hide check to conceal yourself from enemies, slink past guards, slip away without being noticed, or sneak up on people without being seen or heard.
Your Listen check is either made against a DC that reflects how quiet the noise is that you might hear, or it is opposed by the target's Move Silently check.
Make a Move Silently check when you try to sneak past enemies or move without being heard.
Your Spot check is either made against a DC that reflects how obvious the object is, or it is opposed by the target's Hide check.
You are skilled at surviving in the wild and at following tracks.

What it does (SRD): The creature can see in total darkness out to the distance set on each copy (overrides or the stat block). Darkvision is black and white only unless another rule says otherwise.

ThirdEra: Canonical template uses a blank range under Capability grants; set per-copy distance under CGS parameters and overrides.

What it does (SRD): In starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar dim lighting, the creature can see twice as far as a human can in the same light. It retains the ability to distinguish color and detail under those conditions that a human could not.

ThirdEra: Low-light vision is set on this item’s Details tab under Capability grants (vision and senses), not in Mechanical effects (no extra distance is needed for the usual reading of the rule). The character sheet includes it with other vision from items and race.

What it does (SRD): Scent lets the creature detect opponents by smell, usually out to about 30 ft. (strong scents farther, very weak scents closer). It can use scent to pinpoint a square once it is within 5 ft., and to track by Survival. Wind and water affect what it can smell.

ThirdEra: Scent (30 ft.) is set on this item’s Details tab under Capability grants (vision and senses), not in Mechanical effects. The character sheet includes it with other senses; Survival checks to track by scent still use the normal skill rules unless you add separate bonuses elsewhere.

Bay (Su): Supernatural bark with fear effect in listed radius; Will negates per stat block.

Trip (Ex): Bite hit may trip as wolf; opposed Str/Dex check.

Shadow blend (Ex): Concealment in shadowy light except in bright daylight.
